intro: This trial marks the intellectual examination in a broader series of spiritual tests originating in Thousand Needles. After scouring the world for historical texts, initiates present themselves to Parqual Fintallas in the Undercity to prove they understand the darker histories that shape Azeroth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So the time is once again upon us. As a student of lore, you have shown great tenacity by undertaking my task.
And so now I offer you your question. If you are ready, speak to me again, and take all the time you need, friend--there is no pressure to answer quickly.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is only one rule I feel you must know if you wish to survive in this world: the more you know, the more you'll see.
If you study, if you observe, then you will begin to see things in the world that no other traveler will see.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. I had my doubts if you studied the text I asked you to get, but you've answered correctly.
